Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Hanno Chamber of Commerce, in partnership with the Japan Finance Corporation Kawagoe Branch, will hold a one-day consultation session.

On this day, the Kawagoe Branch's area representative will be stationed at the Chamber office all day. Business owners who normally cannot travel to Kawagoe for consultations are encouraged to take advantage of this opportunity.

We accept inquiries not only about Marukeí Financing (government small business loans) but also about other types of financing.

Advance reservation is preferred for consultations. Please contact the Chamber office to check reservation availability.

【Event Details】

Date and Time: Monday, June 15, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
Venue: Hanno Chamber of Commerce, Reception Room
Staff: Yuri Kaneko, Japan Finance Corporation Kawagoe Branch

【How to Reserve】
Complete the reservation form on the attached flyer and submit by FAX or online Forms.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2686/
